leaderboard_scope: The same4 precise profiles and100 planned pegs per backend, one deterministic run each. Ranks describe coarse endpoint seating only, not physical accuracy.
limitations: No complete 20-200 um GPU precision qualification was achieved. Geometry conversion passes, while dynamics contain explicit failures.

Free-drop seating and endpoint deltas do not measure quasistatic lateral/tilt/yaw gap, contact onset or long-time stability. The planned 5 um/10%-clearance and 2 um/5%-clearance thresholds are displayed only as endpoint diagnostics here.

The original CPU-initialized/MultiCCD-on 200um reference comparison fails the endpoint diagnostic in one cell:23.637um versus10um. A separate matched-parameter/Warp-recomputed comparison passes with0.784861um maximum; native health accounting remains unavailable.
20 um native Newton fails a false planar classification of a nonzero-volume 6-vertex prism; no collider was removed, thickened or replaced.

The official primitive sampler retains roughly100 um curved-outline tessellation by default. The low-clearance unchanged-tessellation profiles emit28/29 warnings at20/50 um. Their exact polygon gaps remain valid, but their intended curved outlines are not micrometer-qualified. Separate precise profiles set shape max_error to0.1 clearance and retain actual plus sampled configurations.

All cases use one scene containing25 grid cells, seed0. Grid cells are not independent simulation arenas; there is no12288-arena, multi-seed, Default-backend or performance qualification in this report.
All 9 CPU references reported zero warnings/overflow and zero cross-cell contacts. Native cross-cell/overflow health is not exposed by the Scene facade and remains unverified.
Timing values are single correctness-run observations, not repeat-median benchmarks. Device memory and CPU retained memory were not measured; no speedup claims are made.

The host extraction arena was increased from22MiB to512MiB without changing model vertices, geom transforms, masses or inertias. This fixes diagnostic readback allocation, not the NaNs or false planar classification.

Original Warp20um at nconmax16384 logs107 broadphase overflow warnings requesting22289-23340 candidate slots. The unchanged-geometry retry at nconmax32768/njmax196608 completes with zero overflow flags or warnings but225 nonfinite generalized-state entries. Thus candidate capacity was insufficient in the original run, and numeric failure persists after observed overflow is removed.50/100um are separately nonfinite without overflow flags; the numeric cause is unresolved.
